:::{#def-infimum}
#### Infimum (greatest lower bound)

The **infimum** of a nonempty set $A \subseteq \mathbb{R}$,
written $\inf A$,
is the greatest real number $m$ satisfying $m \le a$ for all $a \in A$:

$$\inf A \eqdef \max_{t \in \reals}\cb{t : \all a \in A, a \ge t}$$

If the infimum belongs to $A$, it equals the minimum: $\inf A = \min A$.

:::
